After a safe resource window and explicit inference authorization, verify all source/model hashes and lower scheduling priority before importing/loading the model.

Encode the three fixed cached parity controls. Require normalized vectors to match cached controls with atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-4. On failure stop and investigate representation mismatch; do not retune the tolerance.
Encode at most four of the 93 requests for calibration, validate shape/finite/nonzero norms and normalized checksums, then checkpoint to a separate SQLite sidecar.
Measure runtime/RAM; after acceptable calibration, process remaining requests in bounded resumable batches of two. Encode each hash only once.
Freeze a separate prospective N/yours extension protocol with the same 52 IDs and selected condition pools before calculating N/yours.
Calculate only N/yours from cached references and original-plus-sidecar claim vectors. Reuse saved Y/density unchanged and report stage-specific results.
